card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that sits inside or ends a multi-digit number, usually right after other digits and before a unit or noun such as mg, mL, msec, millibars or times.

modes.label: Last digit before a unit
modes.description: The final digit of a number followed by a measure like mg, mL, msec or millibars.
modes.example: QTc interval of 50<<7>> msec were reported

modes.label: Digit in non-dose numbers
modes.description: A digit within a general count, date or ratio in news or web text.

card.plain: It fires on a digit within a larger number, such as the 3 in 943 or the 7 in 507, mostly just before a unit.
